# Performance

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -q -p chertmem-dev -- perf-doc`; do not edit. -->

This page is generated from `benches/baseline.toml` and the latency
targets in the root `SPEC.md`; do not edit it by hand. After a new
baseline, regenerate it with `cargo run -q -p chertmem-dev -- perf-doc`;
the commit gate's `perf-doc --check` fails while it is stale. How the
benchmarks run, what each suite measures and how the baseline is
updated: [Benchmarks](BENCHMARKS.md).

Every number is the time of 1 call in milliseconds: criterion's median
and the 95th percentile of its samples. A row passes when its median is
under its suite's target; a suite without a target is measured for
scale.
